notes.title: Our initial release and future roadmap (ver. 1.0)
notes.content:
[b]Escort Simulator Initial Early Access Release Ver. 1.0 [/b]

Known issues and features which are currently being worked on:

[list]
[*] Save state for custom escort settings to propagate across to the climax scene.
[/list]

We are working on this as well as including saved escort slots in the main menu so you don't have to go through the customization settings for your favorite escort. Currently the climax scene simply loads the default escort without modifications, so we could implement the core game loop and include full functionality in the initial release. This should not take us too much time to complete, maybe complete is a week or two as this is a fairly high priority to jizz on your own girl. 

[list]
[*] No loading bar or loading screen shown when transferring player to adjacent game scene.
[/list]

This doesn't effect anything with game play, it's just a not so great user experience as it looks like the game has frozen while it buffers the next scene. This should not take us too long to complete, expect it in the next update. 

Future features that are on our roadmap in the very near future:

[list]
[*] 'Hand held' camera animation for the climax camera angles. This will add some life and realism to the jizz shots as they are currently static. Not a major improvement, just something to take advantage of the real time nature of the engine and make it feel a little nit more like a live porn film. 

[*] Adjustable settings for jizz resolution in fluid dynamic emitter. The resolution is currently set to achieve 90 FPS min on most systems that have a NVidia 10 Series or higher video card (which is what we have to dev on). That being said, the fluid dynamics look even more realistic if you dial the resolution up, but this can bring a system to it's knees. Regardless, it should still be a setting for players with a beefier gaming rig as it does look awesome. This might not be added initially as it does not effect most users, and the jizz still looks good at the current settings. 

[*] Along with the last line item, also adjustable settings for rendering quality and resolution. Self explanatory.

[*] Female ejaculation in climax scene. Pissing is climax scene. These are no brainers to add to our fantastic fluid simulation library. The main issue with these added features will be performance as the fluid simulator is very computationally demanding. This can most likely be solved by old allowing one solver at a time, but will still be fun even at that implementation. 
[/list]

We'll add more things to the roadmap as they come up, but these are the line items that we're working on right now that we feel will be what most players that join the early access version of the game might notice as most severe.
